The state Department of Agriculture released the following reports of inspections of regional restaurants, markets and cafeterias conducted between Aug. 23 and Sept. 14.
Lackawanna County
- BEER GUY PIZZA. Address: 86 River ST Carbondale PA 18407. Most Recent Inspection: August 27. Inspection Type: Regular. Violations: Observed food stored directly on the floor in walk-in cooler area, rather than 6 inches off of the floor as required. Food facility does not have available sanitizer test strips or test kit to determine appropriate chlorine sanitizer concentration. The food facility does not have the original certificate for the certified food employee posted in public view. Paper towel dispenser empty at the handwash sink in the kitchen area. Paper towels were placed at the sink duirng this inspection. Compliance: In.

Food facility was using test strips that did not match the sanitizer; changed to chlorine sanitizer until QUAT test strips are in-house. Observed spices unprotected in dry storage area which is subject to potential contamination. Outside waste handling unit and storage area was extremely dirty, sticky, and attracting insects and rodents. Observed several containers of refuse stored outside the food facility and not in the closed waste handling units.
